description: Scrape cryptocurrency data from CoinGecko's free public API. Supports market listings, coin search, detailed coin data, trending coins, and category listings. No API key required.

category.description: Filter markets results to a specific category slug (e.g. decentralized-finance-defi, layer-1, stablecoins). Leave empty for all categories.
category.title: Category filter (markets mode)

coinIds.description: CoinGecko coin IDs to fetch detailed data for (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana). Find IDs at coingecko.com.
coinIds.title: Coin IDs (mode=byId)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxMarketCap.description: Filter out coins with market cap above this value (markets mode).
maxMarketCap.title: Max market cap (USD)

maxRank.description: Filter out coins with market cap rank above this value (markets mode).
maxRank.title: Max market cap rank

minMarketCap.description: Filter out coins with market cap below this value (markets mode).
minMarketCap.title: Min market cap (USD)

minRank.description: Filter out coins with market cap rank below this value (markets mode).
minRank.title: Min market cap rank

mode.description: What data to fetch from CoinGecko.
enumTitles: Markets — list coins by market cap / volume / rank
Search — find coins by name or symbol
By ID — detailed data for specific coin(s)
mode.title: Mode

order.description: How to sort coins in markets mode.
order.title: Sort order

searchQuery.description: Coin name or symbol to search for (mode=search). Example: bitcoin, sol, doge.
searchQuery.title: Search query

vsCurrency.description: Currency used for all price fields (markets and byId modes).
vsCurrency.title: Quote currency

title: CoinGecko Scraper Input
